message: I was just reminiscing about the time my kids thought they could outrun a snowstorm on their bikes. Spoiler alert: they didn’t. As winter approaches, it’s a great time to chat with the little ones about being prepared for the weather. There’s a helpful resource out there that covers winter weather tips, and it might just help us avoid another impromptu bike race in a blizzard. How do you keep your family ready for the unexpected? ❄️
